abstract: Current forecast evaluation tests can only assess forecasts generated at the same frequency. However, in real-world scenarios, predictions for the same economic variable may be made at different frequencies. The existing literature lacks statistical tests for evaluating such forecasts. This paper introduces a new evaluation test for comparing these forecasts. We propose a two-sample t-type test designed to test the equality of means between two potentially correlated time series that are sampled at different frequencies. No current estimator can compute the variance needed to studentize the difference in the sample means, given the potential temporal and cross-correlations, alongside the mixed-frequency nature of the related data. To address this, we propose a block-average-based variance estimator for this purpose. We derive the asymptotic null distribution of our new two-sample t statistic and analyze the test’s local power. Through extensive Monte Carlo simulations, our two-sample test demonstrates favorable size and power properties in finite samples. Notably, in cases with small sample sizes, our approach outperforms existing heuristic methods, which involve discarding data to align forecasts and applying conventional tests. Additionally, we uncover interesting connections with relevant methods in the literature.
title: Statistical Comparison of Forecasts Made at Different Frequencies
title_zh: 不同频率预测的统计比较

abstract: Portfolio performance depends on interactions inside the network of assets. In high dimensions, these interactions are rare and sparse, therefore an inherent and indispensable portfolio risk, network risk, is difficult to quantify. Here a portfolio risk decomposition method is proposed that leads to analytical solutions that provide insights into the accounts for network and idiosyncratic risks. The technical platform is based on Dantzig-type estimator for covariance matrix and eigenvector centrality, which helps reduce estimation error in high-dimensional cases for portfolio optimization. Empirical results show that the network portfolio approach outperforms existing methods out-of-sample on a real dataset and demonstrate the solidity and reliability of our network portfolio and estimation methods from a practical perspective.
title: A Network View on Portfolio Risk
title_zh: 投资组合风险的网络视角

abstract: China's irrigated heartlands face concurrent pressures of aquifer depletion and grain security. We evaluate Hebei's Substituting Groundwater with Surface Water for Irrigation (SGSWI) project—a medium‐scale, short‐haul program—using county‐level panel data and a staggered difference‐in‐differences design that combines water accounts, monthly deep/shallow groundwater levels, meteorological controls and agricultural statistics, supplemented by village/household surveys. We find that the SGSWI project rebalances irrigation sources without raising total agricultural water use: surface water rises by 3.2%, whereas groundwater falls by 2.3%. The program benefits deep aquifers—deep withdrawals decline 5.3% and the depth to the deep water table recovers by 1.85 m—with no detectable effect on shallow systems. Regarding production, grain output increases 8.3%, driven by a 7.4% expansion in sown area and a 3.7% rise in the multiple‐cropping index; yields per unit area, water‐use efficiency and fertiliser use intensity remain unchanged. Effects are larger where projects connect to inter‐provincial transfers and in severely overdrafted counties; dual‐source counties show the biggest output gains but risk rebound in total water use. A recipient‐side cost–benefit accounting yields an internal rate of return (IRR) of 11.55%, with one‐way sensitivity checks showing only moderate sensitivity to groundwater valuation, operational and maintenance (O&M) costs, and tariffs but strong sensitivity to shortfalls in realised transfer volumes. Sustainability, however, is constrained by supply uncertainty, weak inter‐regional coordination, incomplete infrastructure, underdeveloped operation and maintenance and underpricing. Policy priorities include targeting severe overdraft basins, locking in multi‐year delivery commitments, completing and funding ‘last‐mile’ assets, introducing volumetric and tiered tariffs with safeguards and strengthening aquifer‐specific monitoring and accountability.
abstract_zh: 中国灌溉核心地带正面临地下水枯竭与粮食安全的双重压力。本文利用县级面板数据，结合水账户、月度深层/浅层地下水水位、气象控制变量及农业统计数据，辅以村庄/家庭调查，采用交错双重差分法评估了河北省"以地表水替代地下水灌溉"（SGSWI）项目——一项中等规模、短距离调水工程。研究发现，SGSWI项目在未增加农业总用水量的前提下实现了灌溉水源再平衡：地表水用量上升3.2%，地下水用量下降2.3%。该项目对深层含水层产生积极效应——深层地下水开采量减少5.3%，深层地下水位埋深恢复1.85米——但对浅层系统无显著影响。在生产方面，粮食产量增长8.3%，其驱动因素为播种面积扩大7.4%和复种指数提高3.7%；单位面积产量、水分利用效率和化肥施用强度均未发生显著变化。在连接跨省调水工程及严重超采的县域，项目效应更为显著；双水源县域产出增幅最大，但存在总用水量反弹风险。基于受水区成本收益核算，项目内部收益率（IRR）为11.55%，单向敏感性检验显示其对地下水估值、运维成本及水价仅呈中度敏感，但对实际调水量缺口高度敏感。然而，项目可持续性受制于供水不确定性、区域协调不足、基础设施不完善、运维机制不健全及水价偏低等因素。政策优先方向包括：聚焦严重超采流域、锁定多年调水承诺、完成并资助"最后一公里"设施建设、引入带保障机制的计量阶梯水价、强化针对特定含水层的监测与问责体系。

abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) is undergoing a rapid transition to a weather‐dependent and increasingly distributed system. This article draws on the 2025 NEM Review to examine whether the core energy‐only market design remains fit for purpose. It argues that the principal challenge is not the operation of the spot market, but the weakening of linkages between short‐term dispatch, medium‐term risk management and long‐term investment. The growth of behind‐the‐meter resources has reduced system visibility, the shift to renewable generation has altered the nature of risk, and a structural mismatch between contracting horizons and asset lives has created a ‘tenor gap’. Policy responses should therefore focus on improving visibility, strengthening forward markets and introducing targeted mechanisms to support long‐term investment while preserving market signals.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）正快速向依赖天气且日益分散的系统转型。本文基于2025年NEM评估报告，探讨核心的纯电能市场设计是否仍适用。研究认为，主要挑战并非现货市场的运行，而是短期调度、中期风险管理与长期投资之间关联的弱化。表计后端资源的增长降低了系统可见性，可再生能源发电的转变改变了风险性质，而合约期限与资产寿命之间的结构性错配形成了"期限缺口"。因此，政策应对应聚焦于提升可见性、强化远期市场，并在保留市场信号的同时引入针对性机制以支持长期投资。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Market Design in a Weather‐Dependent and Distributed Electricity System: Lessons From the 2025 NEM Review

abstract: Following the 2022 US Supreme Court decision Dobbs v Jackson, many states adopted early-term abortion (ETA) bans that prohibit abortions before the age of viability and often before sex determination is technologically feasible. We analyze the effect of ETA bans on the sex ratio at birth among first-generation Chinese, Korean, and Indian (CKI) immigrants using difference-in-differences and triple differences methodologies. While our estimates across higher parity children sometimes indicate a decrease in the sex ratio at birth, they are also generally small and statistically insignificant, which is consistent with continued access to sex selection under ETA bans. In contrast, we find that ETA bans are associated with a large and statistically significant increase in the sex ratio at birth among first-parity children to immigrant CKI women. As elevated sex ratios have not been previously documented on first-parity children, this may indicate that ETA bans shift sex-selective behavior to earlier parities by placing additional emphasis on having a boy now, before any further restrictions on abortions occur. Our estimates suggest that ETA bans caused 139 missing, first-born girls in 2023 alone.
abstract_zh: 2022年美国最高法院对多布斯诉杰克逊案作出裁决后，许多州通过了早期堕胎禁令，禁止在胎儿存活期之前（且通常在技术无法确定胎儿性别之前）实施堕胎。我们采用双重差分法和三重差分法，分析了早期堕胎禁令对第一代华裔、韩裔和印度裔移民出生性别比的影响。尽管对较高胎次子女的估算有时显示出生性别比下降，但这些结果普遍较小且统计上不显著，这与早期堕胎禁令下仍可继续实施性别选择的情况一致。相反，我们发现早期堕胎禁令与移民华裔、韩裔和印度裔女性第一胎子女的出生性别比大幅且统计上显著上升相关。由于此前未发现第一胎子女存在性别比偏高现象，这可能表明早期堕胎禁令通过强调在进一步堕胎限制实施前优先生育男孩，将性别选择行为提前至更早胎次。我们的估算显示，仅2023年，早期堕胎禁令就导致139名第一胎女婴缺失。

title: Early-term abortion bans and sex selection after Dobbs v Jackson
title_zh: 多布斯诉杰克逊案后的早期堕胎禁令与性别选择

abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在政府与银行集体道德风险背景下，跨国风险分担与银行资本要求的最优设计。转移支付虽能提供保险，但会削弱财政纪律。由于宽松的财政政策会加剧银行的风险转移行为，最优支持必须取决于银行体系的健康状况。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机中若银行具备偿付能力，支持力度更大；对于财政强劲的国家，在主权与银行双重危机中支持力度更大，这要求存款保险实现共同化。与无跨国转移支付的情形相比，最优合约设定的资本要求更低，这通过提高主权与银行双重危机的成本来强化财政纪律，并促进更大程度的风险分担。
title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
title_zh: 集体道德风险、风险分担与银行业联盟

abstract: This paper utilizes detailed transaction-destination-level data from Finland for years 2013-2019 to examine how multinational enterprises adjust transfer prices to shift profit from high tax countries to low tax countries. Employing a triple difference strategy that leverages variations in corporate income tax rates and affiliate ownership, I provide robust evidence that multinational enterprises underprice exports to low tax destinations. Additionally, my findings suggest that transfer pricing serves as a complementary channel of profit shifting, as firms more prone to other profit shifting mechanisms also underprice their exports more. Furthermore, I provide evidence that firms with more affiliates as well as firms with tax haven affiliates transfer misprice more. My results also suggest asymmetries: while there is clear evidence of transfer mispricing in exports to low tax destinations, there is no consistent evidence of transfer mispricing in imports.
abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰2013-2019年间详细的交易目的地层面数据，考察跨国企业如何调整转让定价以将利润从高税国家转移至低税国家。通过采用三重差分策略，利用企业所得税税率及关联企业所有权的差异，我提供了有力证据表明跨国企业对低税目的地的出口存在定价偏低现象。此外，研究结果显示，转让定价作为利润转移的补充渠道，那些更倾向于采用其他利润转移机制的企业，其出口定价偏低程度也更大。进一步地，我证明拥有更多关联企业以及设有避税天堂关联企业的公司，其转让定价偏差更为显著。研究结果还揭示了不对称性：尽管对低税目的地的出口存在明确的转让定价偏差证据，但在进口方面并未发现一致的转让定价偏差证据。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Exploring heterogeneity and asymmetries in transfer pricing: evidence from Finland
title_zh: 探索转让定价中的异质性与非对称性：来自芬兰的证据

abstract: We study whether term limits can accelerate women’s access to top political positions by analyzing two reforms in Italian local elections that extended mayoral term limits from two to three five-year terms. In a period marked by rapid growth in women’s political participation, the first reform affected municipalities with fewer than 3000 inhabitants in 2014, and the second those below 5000 in 2022. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, we find that longer term limits restrict opportunities for early-career politicians, with substantial effects on female representation: the share of female mayors would be 8 percentage points higher without the term limit extensions. The impact is larger in municipalities with more women in lower political positions and where gender quotas for council members are present, suggesting that entry-level quotas can be more effective when paired with policies promoting turnover in top positions. • Italy extended mayoral term limits below population thresholds in 2014 and 2022. • We use a difference-in-discontinuities design at the 3000 and 5000 cutoffs. • Without the reforms, the share of female mayors would be 8 p.p. higher. • The effect operates through incumbent retention, not gender preferences for tenure. • Term limits complement entry-level gender quotas in promoting female representation.
abstract_zh: 我们通过分析意大利地方选举中的两项改革来研究任期限制能否加速女性获得最高政治职位的机会，这两项改革将市长任期限制从两届延长至三届五年任期。在一个女性政治参与迅速增长的时代，第一项改革于2014年影响了居民少于3000人的市镇，第二项改革于2022年影响了居民少于5000人的市镇。利用断点回归中的差异设计，我们发现更长的任期限制限制了早期职业政治家的机会，对女性代表产生了显著影响：如果没有延长任期限制，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。这种影响在女性在较低政治职位中占比较多以及存在市议会成员性别配额的市镇中更为显著，这表明入门级配额在配合促进高层职位轮换的政策时可能更为有效。• 意大利在2014年和2022年按人口阈值延长了市长任期限制。• 我们使用3000和5000人口截断点的差异断点回归设计。• 如果没有改革，女性市长的比例将高出8个百分点。• 这种效应通过现任者留任发挥作用，而非性别对任期的偏好。• 任期限制与入门级性别配额相辅相成，共同促进女性代表。
title: Gender equality through turnover: Quasi-experimental evidence from term limit reforms in Italy
title_zh: 通过人员更替实现性别平等：来自意大利任期限制改革的准实验证据

abstract: We examine the rise of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in wartime China. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design and several measures as proxies for the rise of the Party during the Sino-Japanese War (middle- to upper-rank party cadres, grassroots party organization, and guerrilla bases), we find that it grew significantly more in counties occupied by the Japanese Army. However, despite its popularity before the war, the same markers were not statistically significant at that time. We identify two primary channels behind the political ascendancy of the CCP. First, the communists took advantage of the militarily weaker “puppet troops” in charge of administering the loosely held occupied areas. Second, support for the CCP was fueled by a strong anti-Japanese sentiment spurred by war suffering, using civilian casualties and rape cases as proxies for the harm inflicted. Finally, the CCP’s wartime influence persisted after the war: former Japanese Occupied Areas exhibited a significantly higher density of party membership between 1950 and 1980.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国共产党在战时中国的崛起。利用空间断点回归设计，并以多项指标（中高级党员干部、基层党组织及游击根据地）作为党在抗日战争期间崛起的代理变量，我们发现党在日军占领的县域中发展显著更快。然而，尽管战前该党已具声望，但同一指标在战前并不具有统计显著性。我们识别出中共政治崛起的两个主要渠道：首先，共产党利用了负责管理松散占领区的军事上较弱的“伪军”；其次，以平民伤亡和强奸案件作为战争伤害的代理变量，由战争苦难激发的强烈抗日情绪推动了民众对中共的支持。最后，中共的战时影响力在战后持续存在：1950年至1980年间，原日军占领区的党员密度显著更高。

abstract: • First randomized controlled trial of a home garden and nutrition intervention in a refugee camp. • Trial included 1,050 pregnant/lactating women, equally split between control and treatment. • Garden adoption increased 17 percentage points (pp); share of households eating produce from own garden increased 57 pp. • Household food insecurity reduced by 66%; fruit intake increased, but vegetable intake did not. • The study shows the positive impact of garden interventions despite extreme space constraints in refugee camps. Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
abstract_zh: • 首个在难民营中开展的家庭菜园与营养干预的随机对照试验。• 试验纳入1,050名孕妇及哺乳期妇女，对照组与干预组人数均等。• 菜园采用率提高了17个百分点；自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点。• 家庭粮食不安全状况降低了66%；水果摄入量增加，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著变化。• 研究表明，尽管难民营空间极为有限，菜园干预仍能产生积极影响。近百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民，聚居在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的营地中。虽然食品援助解决了部分即时需求，但许多人已在营地生活多年，返乡希望渺茫，因此需要更多解决方案以促进自力更生。菜园种植是改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的一种途径，但关于难民营中家庭菜园项目效果的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估家庭菜园与营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营中孕妇及哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用整群随机对照试验设计，在干预前后收集了1,050名妇女的数据，对照组与干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量来衡量意向性治疗效果。空间不足是种植的主要障碍，但袋装菜园和屋顶菜园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告了种植带来的诸多非饮食益处，如个人愉悦感和美化居住环境。干预使菜园采用率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），自产蔬果的家庭比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。同时，营养知识水平提高了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全状况改善了66%（p < 0.05）。干预还使每周水果摄入量显著增加了1份，但蔬菜摄入量未见显著增加。这些发现明确表明，在人口密集的难民营中，为营养脆弱妇女提供菜园种植和营养培训具有显著益处。
title: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
title_zh: 孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女园艺与营养支持的影响

abstract: The protracted fall in the real interest rate of the 1991–2020 period indicates that global demand for financial assets grew much faster than supply. We propose a two-region model of private capital flows to show that two drivers of global prosperity played a key role in this phenomenon: faster growth in emerging economies (EMEs) and financial development in advanced (AEs) and emerging economies. The model also predicts that asset portfolios became riskier and made countries more vulnerable to financial crises, increasing output volatility worldwide. The faster growth of EMEs accounts for 18% and 13% of the rise in volatility in EMEs and AEs, respectively, and it also produced large welfare gains for EMEs. Changes in the financial structure of both regions also contributed to increase output volatility, producing gains for entrepreneurs and losses for households.
abstract_zh: 1991年至2020年间实际利率的持续下降表明，全球对金融资产的需求增长远快于供给。我们提出一个两区域私人资本流动模型，以证明全球繁荣的两大驱动力在这一现象中发挥了关键作用：新兴经济体的更快增长以及发达经济体和新兴经济体的金融发展。该模型还预测，资产组合变得更加风险化，使各国更易遭受金融危机，从而加剧了全球产出波动。新兴经济体的更快增长分别解释了新兴经济体和发达经济体波动性上升的18%和13%，同时也为新兴经济体带来了巨大的福利收益。两个地区金融结构的变化也促进了产出波动的增加，为企业家带来收益，却使家庭遭受损失。
title: Unstable prosperity: How globalization made the world economy more volatile
title_zh: 不稳定的繁荣：全球化如何加剧世界经济波动

abstract: This study provides the first empirical evidence on the impact of the Tigray War on children’s education and child labor in Ethiopia. We combine panel data from the 2018/19 and 2021/22 waves of the Ethiopian Socioeconomic Survey with geocoded conflict data from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project. The analysis focuses on children aged 7–18 across Ethiopia, excluding Tigray due to data limitations and endogeneity concerns. We estimate a Difference-in-Differences model with child fixed effects to compare pre- and post-war outcomes based on proximity to conflict events. Results show that children near conflict zones were significantly less likely to attend school or plan future enrollment with effects concentrated among boys. Conflict exposure also increased child labor, particularly unpaid work for other households and state-led labor among boys. Further analysis and anecdotal evidence suggest that insecurity and state mobilization contributed to boys’ labor participation, ultimately disrupting their education.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次提供了关于提格雷战争对埃塞俄比亚儿童教育及童工影响的实证证据。我们结合了埃塞俄比亚社会经济调查2018/19及2021/22两轮的面板数据，以及来自武装冲突地点与事件数据项目的地理编码冲突数据。分析聚焦于埃塞俄比亚全国7至18岁的儿童，由于数据限制和内生性问题，提格雷地区被排除在外。我们采用带有儿童固定效应的双重差分模型，根据与冲突事件的邻近程度比较战前与战后的结果。结果显示，靠近冲突区域的儿童上学或计划未来入学的可能性显著降低，这一影响主要集中在男孩群体中。冲突暴露还增加了童工现象，特别是男孩为其他家庭从事的无偿劳动及国家主导的劳动。进一步的分析及轶事证据表明，不安全因素和国家动员促进了男孩的劳动参与，最终干扰了他们的教育。
title: The impact of the Tigray war on child education and labor in Ethiopia
title_zh: 提格雷战争对埃塞俄比亚儿童教育与劳动的影响

abstract: We document a prominent yet underappreciated feature of the post-2000 Chinese economy: a vertical structure in which key upstream industries are dominated by state-owned enterprises (SOEs), while downstream industries are largely open to private competition. We develop a general-equilibrium model to analyze how this vertical structure—interacting with industrialization, globalization, and labor abundance—has shaped the Chinese economy. The framework offers new insights into SOE profitability, structural change, resource misallocation, and economic reform. First, upstream SOEs become more profitable as downstream private firms raise their productivity and face greater external demand during industrialization and globalization, helping explain the unprecedented prosperity of SOEs between 2002 and 2007. Second, reducing upstream market power would facilitate labor reallocation from agriculture to non-agricultural sectors, raising GDP and aggregate welfare. Third, preferential credit subsidies to SOEs can improve welfare by alleviating upstream under-supply; consequently, removing these subsidies without dismantling SOE monopoly power could reduce welfare. Quantitative analyses using firm-level data support the theoretical findings. We further show that this vertical structure can arise endogenously as an equilibrium outcome.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了中国2000年后经济中一个显著但未得到充分认识的特征：一种纵向结构，其中关键上游行业由国有企业主导，而下游行业则基本向私营竞争开放。我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，分析这种纵向结构——与工业化、全球化和劳动力充裕相互作用——如何塑造了中国经济。该框架为国有企业盈利能力、结构变迁、资源错配和经济改革提供了新的见解。首先，随着下游私营企业提高生产率并在工业化和全球化过程中面临更大的外部需求，上游国有企业变得更加盈利，这有助于解释2002年至2007年间国有企业前所未有的繁荣。其次，减少上游市场势力将促进劳动力从农业向非农业部门重新配置，从而提高GDP和总体福利。第三，对国有企业的优惠信贷补贴可以通过缓解上游供给不足来改善福利；因此，在不瓦解国有企业垄断势力的情况下取消这些补贴可能会降低福利。基于企业层面数据的定量分析支持了理论发现。我们进一步表明，这种纵向结构可以作为均衡结果内生地出现。
